labs.title: Choose your wish
review: Is the result small enough to inspect?
Can you explain why it matters and what remains your judgment?

labs.title: Map the unfamiliar
review: Can you locate each role without relying on screen coordinates?
Did you distinguish organizing work from enforcing access?

labs.title: Direct your first sidekick
review: Do all three rows trace to their sources?
Does Harbor fail the hard width limit?
Is Cedar delivery still unknown?

labs.title: Check and repair a result
review: Did you identify the invented Cedar delivery?
Did you repair Harbor eligibility instead of averaging away the constraint error?

labs.title: Teach your sidekick your method
review: Are unknown owners and dates still unknown?
Did you keep a suggestion separate from a decision?
Can you point to evidence that your revision helped?

labs.title: Follow the loop
review: Did you record predictions before observing the result?
Can you explain a mismatch without treating every different click as failure?

labs.title: Plan work that can overlap
review: Is a claimed dependency really needed?
Could two branches overwrite the same file?
Did you distinguish asynchronous from concurrent work?

labs.title: Choose a useful connection
review: Does the connection unlock something your wish needs?
Is the status honestly planned, blocked, or tested?
Can useful work continue with a local file?

labs.title: Use your model somewhere new
review: Did your criteria change for this task?
Were two claims checked against event source IDs?
Did observation lead to a specific model revision?

labs.title: Choose your next seven days
review: Are the three opportunities concrete enough to start?
Does the plan include a stop rule and a review point?
Did you keep analyzed and executed evidence separate?
